name: yof
description: Checks code for leaked keys and made-up packages, on your computer.
long_description: yof scans a project folder for leaked keys and made-up or risky packages. Scans run on your computer and never upload code. With your yof key it can also read your yof.io findings and Patch pull requests (it sends only ids and rule ids).

tools.name: yof_check
tools.description: Scan the project folder for leaked keys and made-up or risky packages.

tools.name: yof_check_diff
tools.description: Scan only what changed since the last commit.

tools.name: yof_explain
tools.description: What a finding means and the safe fix.

tools.name: yof_fix_prompt
tools.description: Exact fix steps for one finding.

tools.name: yof_verify
tools.description: Re-scan one file and say fixed or not.

tools.name: yof_findings
tools.description: Open findings from your yof.io account.

tools.name: yof_patch_status
tools.description: Patch's open pull requests and their CI state.

api_key.title: yof key (optional)
api_key.description: From Connect your AI builder in the yof dashboard. Leave empty to use only the local checks.
